newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Vickers says subscribe SMB IPO.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vickers says subscribe SMB IPO.

text.p: Vickers Ballas said on Wednesday investors should subscribe for shares in the SMB United Ltd initial public offer (IPO).

Vickers said in a research note SMB shares were priced at an undemanding 11.7 times on its 1996 earnings, which is at a 55 percent discount to the market. The other stock in the industry is Clipsal Industries, trading at a PE of 18 times.
SMB is a Singapore-based manufacturer of low voltage switchgears for use in power distribution and has an estimated 10 percent share of the domestic market.

The company is offering 103.1 million shares at Singapore $0.29 a share. The net proceeds million will be used to buy a new factory in Singapore, set up a plant in Malaysia and finance the group's overseas expansion.
The IPO closes on September 19 and trading on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore will begin on September 23.
